chapter.title: Steam 'n' Rails
chapter.subtitle: Start with the Monorail Track and follow the chain

quests.title: Monorail Track
quests.subtitle: Your first rail
description: Monorail tracks carry trains on elevated single-rail lines - faster and sleeker than vanilla Create track. Lay 8 to start.
Next: a Semaphore to signal your trains.

quests.title: Semaphore
quests.subtitle: Signal your trains
description: A Semaphore signals trains and controls track segments to prevent collisions.
Next: a Conductor Whistle to summon a conductor.

quests.title: Conductor Whistle
quests.subtitle: Summon a conductor
description: The Conductor Whistle summons a conductor mob who can drive your trains for you.
Next: a Handcar for manual rail travel.

quests.title: Handcar
quests.subtitle: Manual rail transport
description: A Handcar is a small manual rail vehicle - no fuel, no train assembly, just pump to move.
Next: lay 32 Monorail Tracks to connect your base to an outpost.

quests.title: Rail Line
quests.subtitle: Connect your base to an outpost
description: Lay at least 32 Monorail Tracks to link your base with a mine or farm outpost. A dedicated line keeps resources flowing.

quests.title: Rail Network
quests.subtitle: Link multiple bases
description: Lay at least 64 Monorail Tracks to connect your bases, colony, and factories into one rail network.
This completes the Steam 'n' Rails chapter.

quests.title: Wide Track
quests.subtitle: Heavy-duty rails
description: Wide Track is a heavier rail variant for bigger, faster trains.

quests.title: Coupler
quests.subtitle: Join train cars
description: A Coupler links train cars together into longer trains.

quests.title: Remote Lens
quests.subtitle: Control trains from afar
description: A Remote Lens lets you control trains and signals from a distance.
